vulnerability.title: Add noexec Option to /home
vulnerability.description: The noexec mount option can be used to prevent binaries from being executed out of /home. Add the noexec option to the fourth column of /etc/fstab for the line which controls mounting of /home.
vulnerability.recommendation: Remediation script: # Remediation is applicable only in certain platforms if ( ! ( { rpm --quiet -q kernel-core ;} && { rpm --quiet -q rpm-ostree ;} && { rpm --quiet -q bootc ;} && { ! rpm --quiet -q openshift-kubelet ;} && ([ -f /run/ostree-booted ] || [ -L /ostree ]) ) && ! ( [ -f /.dockerenv ] || [ -f /run/.containerenv ] ) ); then function perform_remediation { # the mount point /home has to be defined in /etc/fstab # before this remediation can be executed. In case it is not defined, the # remediation aborts and no changes regarding the mount point are done. mount_point_match_regexp="$(printf "^[[:space:]]*[^#].*[[:space:]]%s[[:space:]]" "/home")" grep "$mount_point_match_regexp" -q /etc/fstab \ || { echo "The mount point '/home' is not even in /etc/fstab, so we can't set up mount options" >&2; echo "Not

triage_decision.reason: Adding the noexec option to /home is a standard hardening practice that does not affect authentication, networking, or critical services. It only prevents execution of binaries from /home, which is expected and unlikely to cause lockout or system breakage.
triage_decision.estimated_impact: filesystems affected; Potential disruption of user-installed binaries that rely on execution from /home

Let's construct:

perl -0777 -p -i -e '

This will add noexec at end of line if not present. But if options column contains others, we might end up with noexec appended but not separated by comma? Provided we had options skip 'noexec', we add at end; nothing else. But we need to insert comma if other options present. But this code adds comma before noexec regardless? It just adds noexec as is; if there is no trailing comma, then it will be appended with noexec but missing comma. The pattern adds comma if captured group suffix doesn't include it. We need to check.

Use regex: capture trailing options part, then if options end with comma or nothing? Actually we want to add comma before noexec. Suppose line options is defaults,relatime . Our action: s{(\s+[^#]*?)$}{$1,noexec} . So the captured group is space then whatever last field. Suppose last field 'defaults,relatime 0 2', captured group includes leading space plus whatever up to end. Adding ,noexec will produce ' defaults,relatime,noexec'. Note that no comma before noexec? actually we added ,noexec after the options. So now options become defaults,relatime,noexec. That is fine.

If options is 'noexec' already, we skip due to !/noexec/. Good.

If options is 'noexec' only? That case? We skip. If options is ' defaults' (space before defaults) we still add noexec after defaults: ' defaults,noexec'. Good.

Edge: if options was empty (empty options column)? Fstab syntax usually has at least default 'defaults'. If empty, field may be blank? But you rarely see empty; anyway would still add noexec.

Thus perl command is fine.

So plan:
